authority.note: The markdown is the authoritative wording; this file transcribes it for the frozen instrument.

research_question: Does limiting passive enemy-anchor visibility to min(declared reach, 32) cells make the best allocation of actions depend on the opponent, or does it act only as a discovery tax?

O-2.decision: A ninth member, LURK (search none, posture attack)

O-5.decision: The tick bound for a forced-line capture

O-8.decided: E4 cell metrics (FMA and FPS), descriptive only

P-1.decided: 40 GB, with the subset of seed positions 1-4. Callback telemetry stays complete for every cell.

P-2.decided: [8, 64], sign and magnitude drawn from the seeded RNG

P-4.decided: One cyclic own-core READ per tick: at the first callback of tick t, own-core cell (t - 1) mod 8

P-5.decided: Outward alternating painting, starting side drawn from the seeded RNG

P-6.decision: Unverified adoption at the first callback

treatment.rule: a friendly process with declared reach r sees an enemy anchor iff their circular distance is <= min(r, 32); inclusive

population.packages: a primary and a twin per member; opaque package IDs; one byte-identical policy source

F1.pairs: every ordered pair of distinct members

O-PAYOFF.per_seed: mean of i's value over the two F1 orientations
O-PAYOFF.u: mean of p_s over the 32 seeds

O-BR.best_response: i in Pi_F with u(i, j) >= max_k u(k, j) - epsilon
O-BR.universal: in BR_eps(j) for every j in Pi
O-BR.P_none: no member of Pi_F is universal

O-CONTACT.definition: some entrant writes a cell of the opponent's core, from replay memory diffs and tick-0 cores

E6-D.name: Seed commitment
E6-D.when: after the frozen gameplay analysis, before interpretation

CQ-1.condition: identical action streams in every matched control cell

E6-H1T.statement: The best response under T-E6 is not constant
E6-H1T.supported: P_none at the point estimate and stab(P_none) >= 9/10
E6-H1T.refuted: not P_none at the point estimate and stab(not P_none) >= 9/10

E6-H1C.statement: The best response under C-E6 is not constant

E6-H2.statement: Less information can win under T-E6
E6-H2.supported: P_win at the point estimate and stab(P_win) >= 9/10
E6-H2.refuted: P_never at the point estimate and stab(P_never) >= 9/10

E6-H0.statement: Delay only: priced sensing is a discovery tax
E6-H0.A: share of paired F1 cells with equal outcome class
E6-H0.B: over the cells counted by A: share with treatment final tick >= control final tick

E6-H3.statement: A delayed forced line defeats every defender
E6-H3.supported: some attacker a has min over d of FL(a, d) >= 9/10
E6-H3.refuted: every attacker a has min over d of FL(a, d) <= 1/10

pathology.PF-1: tick-limit share under T-E6 minus the share under C-E6 >= 1/10
pathology.PF-2: no-hostile-core-contact share under T-E6 minus the share under C-E6 >= 1/10
pathology.PF-3: some member of Pi_F never core-captured in its F1 matches under T-E6 although captured under C-E6
pathology.PF-4: some F1 pairing or F2 mirror with SDom < 9/10 and |GSB| <= 1/10 under C-E6 but SDom >= 9/10 or |GSB| > 1/10 under T-E6

kill_criteria.KC-2: GREED is universal at the point estimate and stab(GREED universal) >= 9/10

disposition: otherwise REJECT as a gameplay candidate if any KC fires
otherwise CANDIDATE if the row is R-CREATES and E6-H2 is SUPPORTED
evidence_rules: every frozen unit counted; n_distinct beside every figure; a rate needs n_distinct >= 8
payoffs weight every seed equally; tick metrics per match, unit value the median over seeds
control-against-control: E6-H0 SUPPORTED (A = B = 1), E6-H2 REFUTED, no PF raised, E6-H1T = E6-H1C
the companion never replaces a primary verdict
ADAPT is never a condition of a row or a kill
no threshold, set, operationalization, row or rule changes after any matrix cell exists
